title: What they said at the time

clips.q: This could be the pet rock of the beverage industry.
clips.who: **Ed Rogers**, New Products Showcase and Learning Center, Oct 1996[^1]

clips.q: We want to give them something that’s not only delicious but entertaining.
I don’t like any soft drink I have to chew - too gimmicky!
Orbitz is still weird. It’s just not new in 1998.
